title: Port normalization identity and article inheritance with Python fixtures
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
normalize.ts, identity.ts, data-parity.test.ts, and parity-manifest.json are uncommitted working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.
Python validate_laws and validate_articles abort the frame when any id is null. This port quarantines that row and continues the batch.
Title-shell parent-span body expansion is not ported.

Full normalize_legal_text is not ported. The subset covers null and NaN, NFKC, controls, NBSP and unicode spaces, dashes, hyphen-break joins, simple HTML and entities, whitespace collapse, and whole-line URL or numeric-date chrome. Latin-1 repair, learned patterns, numero folding, and the rest of gazette chrome stay out. Fixture statute sentences are invariant under the full Python normalizer.
A source value whose entire text is a URL or a numeric date is removed, matching country_laws_ir chrome removal, so those fixture fields are empty. A timestamp such as 2020-05-01T00:00:00Z is kept.

national_directory.py is dirty in the reference worktree. The dirty hunk is national-gap admin level and locators_from_marked_title. It does not change _HEADING_LINE, _TITLE_LOI, _ROMAN, _HEADING_KIND, or _fold. The manifest pins the worktree hash.
The datasets research pin is older than commit 2ea4ca6804b3c4cc44e43d0539f4c3fcae011747. The fixture binds that worktree HEAD.
Snapshot date uses retrieved_at, then date_issued, then date. A column value that conflicts with metadata publication or enactment quarantines the row and chooses neither value.

Article identity records copy parent license, language, jurisdiction, and status the way Python _article_outcome does. schema.ts LawSection does not inherit those fields. Entry CIDs use that parent snapshot.
Citations, bluebook labels, parquet refine_assembled_corpus, admit_source_law, Hugging Face download, structure splitting, and BM25 are not in this task.

Fixture sentences are synthetic structural samples. AGPL-3.0-only binds the upstream code. It is not a corpus redistribution grant. Row license strings are preserved labels and are not a WWL-012 decision.
entry_cid is the identity CID of canonical JSON. It is not sha256_key_to_cidv1 of the body hash. Both are tested. contentCid on schema sections remains caller-supplied.
Folding is NFKD, toLowerCase, and stripping marks. It is not full Python casefold for ß or İ. The fixtures avoid ß.
The entry CID is not recomputed after title inheritance, matching Python.
